description: Presidential Secretariat - Appointed Mr. Herath Yapa as Secretary to the Ministry of Labour from 22.04.2015. Appointed Mr. R. M. W. Rathnayake as Secretary to the State Ministry of Housing & Samurdhi from 31.03.2015
categorisation: This gazette contains only government personnel appointments (Mr. Herath Yapa as Secretary to the Ministry of Labour and Mr. R. M. W. Rathnayake as Secretary to the State Ministry of Housing and Samurdhi) with basic titles only. It does not include detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities or subject matter areas, making it a pure People Gazette according to the classification rules.
